name: Cyril Cermak
bio: Hi I am Cyril, an iOS System Architect with over a decade of experience building cutting-edge mobile applications. I am specializing in leading teams to deliver state-of-the-art mobile engineering solutions. My professional passions include software engineering, iOS security, modular architecture, and reverse engineering iOS apps. I frequently share my expertise through workshops and talks, aiming to inspire others and drive innovation and a practical security mindset within the mobile development community.
